key_insight: MIMIC-Note-Extract turns free-text discharge summaries into reusable structured data, making previously hard-to-access clinical information easier to study.
clinical_relevance: The dataset supports clinical AI research by expanding access to patient histories, allergies, and diagnostic findings documented in discharge summaries.
method: Processes 16 sections from 300,720 MIMIC-IV-Note discharge summaries.
Combines deterministic parsing with schema-guided LLM generation to produce structured tables.
Uses the extracted data to construct a clinical decision-making benchmark for LLM agents.
evidence_signal: Physician validation found extraction accuracy above 92% across sections; MNE provides 10 times more patient-history entries and medication histories for more than twice as many admissions as related structured MIMIC tables.
watch_item: Extraction accuracy does not establish clinical utility or generalizability beyond MIMIC; downstream studies should account for extraction errors.
paper_title: MIMIC-Note-Extract: A Large-Scale Structured Dataset Extracted from MIMIC-IV-Note Discharge Summaries
